title: Determine the Area of Trapezoids
objective: I can find the area of a trapezoid using the formula A = ½(b1 + b2) × h.
model: trapezoid with its two parallel bases and a perpendicular height; two copies make a parallelogram; resized with sliders

widgets.component: number-line placement of the height of a trapezoid with bases 6 and 10 and area 48
widgets.root: The stem prints the solution: '(Hint: 48 = ½ × 16 × h → h = 6)'. The answer 6 is on the screen before the student does anything.
widgets.replacement: Remove the worked hint from the stem ('A trapezoid has bases of 6 ft and 10 ft and an area of 48 sq ft. Place a point at its height.'); put '(6 + 10) × h ÷ 2 = 48, so (6 + 10) × h = 96' in hint 2 of the ladder only. Widen the line to min 0, max 12 and add wrong-answer rules for 3 ('you divided by 16 and forgot to double the area first') and 12 ('you forgot the ½ and divided 48 by 4').

widgets.component: generated trapezoid word problems with a drawn trapezoid (bases, perpendicular height, optional equal slanted sides, 'cut into a rectangle and two triangles')
widgets.root: Two flaws in the generated trapezoid. (1) About a third of the L1 draws (101 of 300) say 'It is cut into a rectangle and two triangles' and ask for the base or area of 'each' triangle or of the rectangle, but the figure draws no cut lines and the stem never says the triangles are identical; the answer ((b2 − b1) ÷ 2) is only valid for an isosceles trapezoid that the figure silently assumes. (2) SHAPES.trap clamps bottom/height to 1.1-3.4, so about 10% of draws are 1.5-2.25 times too squat (bases 11 and 23 over a height of 3 are drawn as 3.4 : 1 instead of 7.7 : 1). Heights are perpendicular, the dashed height starts at a vertex of the top base, and the equal-leg ticks appear when a slanted side is given.
widgets.replacement: In SHAPES.trap add an option {"cuts":true} that dashes the two perpendiculars from the ends of the top base and labels the triangle base (b2 − b1) ÷ 2 and the rectangle, and set it on every 'cut into a rectangle and two triangles' item; change those stems to 'cut into a rectangle and two identical triangles'. Widen the clamp to 1.1-8 and let sc shrink the drawing. Add a studio-gen test that the drawn bottom/height equals dims within 2%.

widgets.component: Connect check: 'What is the area of the trapezoidal driveway?', 'How many bags of concrete does the builder need?', 'Why add the two parallel edges and then take half?' (now carried with the Connect scenario text and the Connect diagram)
widgets.root: The generator now prepends the Connect scenario to each item (ctx), so the givens are on screen, but the figure it attaches is the Connect coordinate plane with only the corner dots plotted: no polygon is drawn, there is no dashed perpendicular height and no right-angle mark (checked by rendering the spec). The student must infer the shape and the height from four unconnected points, which is the representation this lesson exists to teach.
widgets.replacement: Extend diagramToViz (scripts/lib/practice-studio-config.mjs) so a coordinate-plane diagram whose points form a polygon emits "polygon" (point indexes in order) and, for the area lessons, a foot-of-the-height point plus "segments" for the dashed perpendicular.
